C0802.title: Case of a 1069 Code Sub-Agent Assisting Telecom Fraudsters in Sending Phishing SMS
C0802.summary: Chen, operating a tech company as a third-level agent for the '1069' service code, rented out 1069 numbers to telecom fraud criminals. This enabled the criminals to impersonate traffic authorities and financial institutions, sending mass SMS containing phishing short links to victims under the pretext of passing driving exams or applying for online loans, thereby defrauding them of money.
